Select molecule ChEMBL ID, molecule name, maximum development phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for all compounds reported in the specified document. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id, filtering by doc_chembl_id CHEMBL1127197. Use LEFT JOIN compound_structures to retrieve canonical_smiles, allowing nulls for missing structures. Sort the results by molecule_chembl_id and return all columns as specified.
